senses.gloss: ch. same, esp. praising the bride in dancing before her (v.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 3:4">Targ. Koh. III, 4</cite>; a. e.—
Snh. 105ᵃ (prov.) when mouse and cat עבדי ה׳ מבישרא וכ׳ Ms. M. (ed. מתרבא) make a wedding feast, it is from the flesh (fat) of an unlucky (victim).—בי ה׳ wedding house, feast.

<cite ref="Berakhot 6b:17">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>אגרא דבי ה׳ מילי</he> (Var. <he>הִלּוּלֵי</he> pl.) the meritorious act in attending a wedding consists in words (cheering songs, addresses &c.); a. e.—Pl. <he>הִילּוּלֵי</he>, <cite ref="H01091"><he>הִלּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:14">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>בי ר׳ חסדא שתין ה׳</he> sixty weddings were celebrated in the house of R. Ḥ.
<cite ref="Gittin 57a:10">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>ובהך גיסא ה׳ וחינגי</he> and on the other side of the town were weddings and feasts; a. e.
